added: A figure of your own made for English offers English's groups of dancers, such as the ends, the top and the corners, for a group or a pair of dancers, as a default and in a dance. It no longer offers the two groups only contra has, third corners and opposites; an English figure that already holds one of those needs repair. An older version of the app can't read an English figure that holds a group only English has: it is marked Needs repair there, and kept as it is.
changed: Switching an English figure to the app's figure of the same name says that a use of a group of dancers the app's figure lacks keeps its wording instead of switching.

UserFigureParam.spec is replaced by specIn(form), and a dancerSet or dancerPair parameter of a figure made for ecd takes ecdSelectors (userFigureDancerChoices); every other form keeps ParamVocab.dancerSets. userFigureSeedFromMove validates a copy as a figure of its taxonomy's form, and no longer starts a group of dancers from the unspecified default.
